reading.requirement: Exact source text hash and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Official Conversation MP3, current audio hash, alignment and rights checks must pass; no silent directions as evidence.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Same source reading and audio share one exposure group; never count either as unseen after the other.

questions.prompt: What is Anna trying to learn from the tourists?
options: Why they come to Washington, D.C.
answers: Why they come to Washington, D.C.
questions.evidence: Today, my job is to interview tourists. I have to learn why they come here.
questions.explanation: Anna先说明工作是采访游客，紧接着说要了解why they come here。here承接开头的Washington, D.C.。航班时间和旅馆工作并不是她给出的采访目标，不能根据“游客”这个身份自行补充。

spokenEvidence.quote: Today, my job is to interview tourists. I have to learn why they come here.

questions.prompt: Why does Sabrina enjoy visiting monuments and memorials?
options: They are places to buy paintings.
questions.evidence: I like history. So, I like walking around and looking at all the monuments and memorials. They make history come alive!
questions.explanation: Sabrina先说喜欢历史，再用so连接参观纪念建筑的活动；history come alive说明这些地方让历史变得鲜活。免费课程或购买画作不是她给出的理由。要把原因与随后活动联系，而不是只按景点名称猜。

spokenEvidence.quote: I like history. So, I like walking around and looking at all the monuments and memorials. They make history come alive!

questions.prompt: Which place does Sabrina say she especially likes?
questions.evidence: I really like Lincoln Memorial. It is very beautiful.
questions.explanation: 她用really like明确说出自己特别喜欢Lincoln Memorial。Washington Monument是Anna说位于身后的建筑；U.S. Capitol是后面另一位游客想去的地方。附近出现或被别人提到，都不等于Sabrina的偏好。

spokenEvidence.quote: I really like Lincoln Memorial. It is very beautiful.

questions.prompt: Which two languages does Louis say he speaks?
questions.explanation: Louis直接回答I speak Chinese and English，所以这两个语言必须一起选。Farsi来自后面Mehrnoush的回答，不能移到Louis身上；题目也没有说他会Bengali。不要用受访者的国家替代实际说出的语言信息。

questions.prompt: Where does Mehrnoush want to go because of her interest in government and politics?
questions.evidence: I want to see the U.S. Capitol.
questions.explanation: Mehrnoush先说自己喜欢了解政府和政治，随后明确说想参观U.S. Capitol。艺术博物馆属于Louis的偏好，Lincoln Memorial属于Sabrina的偏好。三个地点在同篇都出现，需要按说话人和兴趣分别对应。

spokenEvidence.quote: I want to see the U.S. Capitol.

questions.prompt: What does Anna want to do after finishing the interviews?
options: Look at paintings in a museum.
questions.evidence: Now, I want to do my favorite thing in the city … ride the carousel!
questions.explanation: 结尾Anna说自己现在想做最喜欢的事，随后亲口说明ride the carousel，即乘旋转木马。前面的博物馆和国会大厦是游客谈到的活动，不能因此当作Anna结束采访后的计划。

spokenEvidence.quote: Now, I want to do my favorite thing in the city … ride the carousel!
